patterns.description: 90% of cuts land on the beat (within 70 ms), so the edit is cut to the music.
Cutting speeds up when the drop hits: 0.11 -> 0.65 cuts per second (5.7x faster).
Freeze effects hit on the beat (2 of 2).
Rotate effects hit on the beat (2 of 2).
Zoom effects hit on the beat (7 of 10).
Speed ramps start or land on a beat (11 of 12).
The edit cuts away and comes back to the same clip 2 times (source groups C, F).
